fonts.display: 'KH Teka', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'System sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: The Green
palette.role: Full-bleed identity block for The Green property and any place or section it owns — deep forest green reads as architectural paint, not decoration

palette.name: The Pink
palette.role: Red wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

palette.name: The Red
palette.role: Full-bleed identity block and dramatic section background — vermillion red carries the most visual weight and anchors expanded menu states and signature moments

palette.name: The Yellow
palette.role: Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

palette.name: Concrete
palette.role: Page canvas and primary surface — the light gray ground every screen sits on, treated as a material (concrete, drywall) rather than a neutral

palette.name: Iron
palette.role: Primary text, pill button fills, and most structural borders — near-black rather than pure black, softer on the concrete canvas while keeping max contrast

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Hairline borders, icon strokes, and occasional deep accents where maximum bite is needed against the colored blocks
